crossRefs.note: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.

translations.web: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.
translations.bsb: About three hours later his wife also came in, unaware of what had happened.
translations.kjv: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.
translations.asv: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.
